entities.summary: Dwayne Richard Hipp is an American software developer and the primary author of SQLite, the Fossil SCM, and Pikchr. He also authored the Lemon parser generator, and CVSTrac; the latter became the inspiration for Trac. He was also a member of the Tcl core team.
